setup: Install fonts: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
Configure Tailwind: Update tailwind.config.js to use the specific colors (Emerald-500 as primary, Zinc-950 as background).
Global CSS: Add the noise texture to the body background in index.css.
implementation_rules: Use 'Oswald' for all headings (h1-h3) and betting odds.
Use 'Manrope' for all body text and UI labels.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for transaction hashes, IDs, and precise timestamps.
Ensure all cards have a subtle 1px border (white/10) to define edges in the dark theme.
NEVER use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds; use #050505 or #0a0a0a.
For the 'Live' indicator, use a pulsing red dot (bg-red-500 animate-pulse).
Betting inputs must be large and clear (text-2xl or larger).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
